merged_body: cargo fmt reformats THE ENTIRE workspace, not just the file you touched. Three known footguns: (1) `make fmt` after a subsystem refactor pulls in unrelated formatting cleanup (e.g., context.rs, vex/ops.rs) and bloats the diff. (2) `cargo fmt --manifest-path X.toml -- <file>` does NOT scope rustfmt to <file>; the <file> arg is silently ignored. (3) Cleanup after large surgeries (e.g., deleting old VEX interpreter dead code) mixes unrelated fmt changes into the bead's diff if you stage with `git add -A`. Workflow: after `make fmt` / `cargo fmt`, do `git status` and `git checkout --` the files you didn't intend to touch (or run rustfmt directly on the single file). Encountered 2026-05-21 in angr-borb.1 (Address newtype) — touched 12 unrelated files — and angr-hfr0 — touched 13 unrelated files.
